title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
title_zh: 安全强化学习用于多轮临床智能体：密集奖励何时优于结果奖励
summary_en: The paper studies reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for multi-turn clinical agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop, and which action to take. It introduces three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden states, query costs, and deterministic verifiers. Outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward but causes undesirable procedures like premature commitment and one-question collapse, and fails on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, dense credit for uncertainty-reducing questions improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three seeds without high-risk collapse, while separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Optimal process credit strength is task-dependent, and after supervised warmup, RL raises aggregate reward by trimming questions but degrades high-risk performance.
summary_zh: 本文研究了基于可验证奖励的强化学习在多轮临床智能体中的应用，这些智能体需决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取何种行动。作者引入了三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境均包含隐藏临床状态、查询成本、精确自适应预言机和确定性结果验证器。仅使用结果奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）通常能提升总体奖励，但会产生不良流程，如过早承诺、单问题崩溃以及在罕见高风险病例上失败。在诊断任务中，对降低不确定性的问题分配密集信用，相比仅结果强化学习，在三个训练种子下均提升了留出价值和中等病例支持度，且未出现仅结果训练中的高风险种子崩溃。将探索与利用分离进一步提升了最佳检查点的高风险支持度，但代价是在低 acuity 病例上过度收集信息。额外实验表明，过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已进行谨慎信息收集的监督预热后，强化学习通过削减问题提升总体奖励，但会降低高风险性能。
content_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. content_zh: 使用可验证奖励的强化学习正越来越多地用于改进语言模型推理，但其对序列决策过程的影响仍鲜为人知。我们在临床多轮智能体中研究这一问题，这类智能体必须决定请求哪些信息、何时停止收集证据以及采取哪项行动。我们引入了三个受控环境：药物续方分诊、急性诊断检查和剂量滴定，每个环境都具有隐藏的临床状态、查询成本、精确的自适应预言机和确定性的结果验证器。在这些任务中，仅基于结果的分组相对策略优化往往能提高总体奖励，却会产生不良流程，包括过早承诺、单问题坍缩以及在罕见高风险病例上的失败。在诊断任务中，与仅基于结果的强化学习相比，对降低不确定性的问题分配密集信用，可在三个训练种子下改善留出价值和中等病例支持，且未出现仅基于结果训练中观察到的高风险种子坍缩。将探索与利用分离，在其最佳检查点进一步提高了高风险支持，但代价是在低急症病例上过度收集信息。额外实验表明，过程信用的最优强度取决于任务；在已经谨慎收集信息的监督预热之后，强化学习通过削减问题来提高总体奖励，却降低了高风险性能。
